user.title: Sign in to Steam
user.description:
Open this link on your phone, with the Steam app installed, and approve the sign-in:

{url}

Then submit this form.

Home Assistant never sees your Steam password - Steam authenticates you on your phone and returns a token.

pin.title: Family View PIN
pin.description: Steam requires the parental PIN for every change. It is checked now by writing your own settings back unchanged.

retry.title: Try again
retry.description: The sign-in was not approved. Submit to generate a fresh link.

error.not_approved: The sign-in was not approved in time. A new link has been generated.

abort.no_steamid: Steam did not return an account ID.
abort.already_configured: That Steam account is already set up.

progress.awaiting_approval: Waiting for you to approve the sign-in in the Steam app...
